_comment: One object per scoreboard row id. Amendment keys: `norm` (the value), `unit`, `better` (lower|higher|null), `ratchets` (a row that beat the free-agent bar in a RELEASED version: {pair, factory_model, since, value, bar}; the Lead commits an element after `compare --release` printed `can ratchet:`), `raises` (a NORM raise {raised_by, reason, word, from, to}; a RATCHET raise {ratchet: "<pair>@<factory model>", raised_by, reason, word}, no from/to, scoped to that one element and legalising no norm change), `worsened_passes` ({version, pair, factory_model, word, quote}; a new entry names the factory model it clears). Kept from norms/1 unchanged: `id` (the norm id), `kind`, `op`, `bar_row`, `unknown_row`, `initial`, `ratcheted_since`, `carrier`. Tighten-only (AR-20, K5): `initial` never changes; tightening edits `norm` in a Lead commit; a looser `norm` needs a `raises` element with the owner's `word`; a `ratchets` element is never removed and its `value` never worsens without a new `raises` element carrying a `word`. Top level `bar_changes` ({bar, word, decision: keep|lift}) answers a new bar that beats the factory (OQ2). Initial values are the LR2-1 measurement, spec section 5. Check: python -B experiments/measurers/scoreboard.py norms --check [--against <older norms.json>]

F1.carrier: t-357 :119 (8,043 of 11,064 s); NOT re-measured by N4 on the arm state under the F3 definition (spec section 5 asks for it)

G1.carrier: t-357 :132 (s5_precheck:manifest); an unknown-check count above the norm makes the verdict unknown (AR-28)
